problem_statement: Quality-time still exposes and implements the deprecated Cobertura Jenkins plugin source.
acceptance_criteria: Remove `cobertura_jenkins_plugin` from the shared source registry and supported metric source lists.
Stop registering the Cobertura Jenkins plugin collector implementations.
Add a focused regression asserting that the plugin is absent from the shared data model.
non_goals: Do not remove support for standalone Cobertura XML reports.
Do not remove other Jenkins plugin sources.
constraints: Do not remove support for standalone Cobertura XML reports.
Do not remove other Jenkins plugin sources.
Do not add dependencies, change lockfiles or CI, update generated output, add binaries or symlinks, or rename files.
Keep the contribution limited to production source and an oracle-bound regression test.

Keep the patch to exactly these five existing files: components/collector/src/source_collectors/__init__.py, components/shared_code/src/shared_data_model/metrics.py, components/shared_code/src/shared_data_model/sources/__init__.py, components/shared_code/src/shared_data_model/sources/quality_time.py, and components/shared_code/tests/shared_data_model/meta/test_data_model.py. Leave the Cobertura Jenkins plugin logo and every other file unchanged.
